_comment: Hand-built realistic design digest source for the B2/B3 author-loop end-to-end test (tidal-kite-generator HOLDOUT, briefs-holdout/tidal-kite-generator.md). Mirrors the real state.json field shapes (parsedBrief / moduleDecomposition / orchestratorContract). The envelope is the DEPLOYMENT-SCENE envelope: kite depicted at the operating point 84 m downstream (+Y) of the seabed gravity anchor, 24 m above seabed, taut 87 m tether (within the brief's 80-120 m tether range). This file is the regression fixture for scripts/author-blender-scene.tsx.

parsedBrief.mission_statement: Harvest predictable tidal-stream energy with a tethered underwater kite that flies a figure-of-eight across the current, multiplying flow velocity over a shrouded turbine.
parsedBrief.product_description: Utility-scale fully-submerged tidal kite: 12 m carbon-composite hydrofoil wing carrying a sealed nacelle with a 1.6 m shrouded axial-flow turbine and 500 kW direct-drive permanent-magnet generator; subsea power electronics export at 3.3 kV down a synthetic tether to a gravity-base seabed foundation; neutrally-to-slightly-positively buoyant, 20-year marine service.

moduleDecomposition.productClassDescription: Tethered subsea tidal-kite energy converter. DEPICT AT THE OPERATING POINT: seabed gravity foundation at the scene origin; kite assembly (wing + nacelle + turbine) 84 m downstream (+Y) of the anchor and 24 m above the seabed; the 87 m tether runs TAUT and STRAIGHT (2-point pipe run) from the foundation padeye up to the nacelle belly. Fore-aft axis of the nacelle = Y (nose into the current, -Y).

modules.module_brief: 12 m span carbon-composite hydrofoil wing, the lifting body the whole kite hangs from; nacelle mounts under the wing centre.

sub_modules.topology_clause: continuous wing spanning X, mounted HIGH over the nacelle so the nacelle hangs beneath the wing centre

modules.module_brief: Sealed cylindrical nacelle slung under the wing centre; structural backbone of the kite; houses generator, power electronics and avionics.

sub_modules.topology_clause: fore-aft along Y under the wing centre; turbine shroud at the nose (-Y), tail surfaces aft (+Y)

modules.module_brief: Shrouded axial-flow water turbine at the nacelle nose; 1.6 m rotor inside a 2.0 m duct shroud.

sub_modules.topology_clause: rotor disc normal to the flow (rotation plane normal to Y), centred on the nacelle axis at the nose

modules.module_brief: 500 kW direct-drive permanent-magnet generator immediately behind the turbine, inside the nacelle.

sub_modules.topology_clause: coaxial with the turbine, inside the nacelle forward section (contained by the nacelle)

modules.module_brief: Subsea variable-speed drive + 3.3 kV export converter in a pressure-rated enclosure in the nacelle aft section.

sub_modules.topology_clause: inside the nacelle aft of the generator (contained by the nacelle)

modules.module_brief: Autonomous flight-control computer with depth/attitude sensing; small sealed pod in the nacelle mid-section.

sub_modules.topology_clause: inside the nacelle mid-section (contained by the nacelle)

modules.module_brief: Wing-tip buoyancy pods trimming the kite to neutral-to-slightly-positive buoyancy.

sub_modules.topology_clause: one pod at each wing tip, axis fore-aft (Y), attached to the wing

modules.module_brief: Aft tail group (boom + elevator + rudder) steering the figure-of-eight trajectory.

sub_modules.topology_clause: boom extends aft (+Y) from the nacelle; elevator + rudder at the boom end

modules.module_brief: 87 m taut synthetic tether (within the 80-120 m brief band) from the nacelle belly to the foundation padeye; carries the 3.3 kV export umbilical; wet-mateable connector at the lower end.

sub_modules.topology_clause: STRAIGHT taut run (2-point) from the foundation padeye at the origin up to the nacelle belly at (0, 84 m, 24 m)

words.name_human: HMPE synthetic tether with embedded 3.3 kV umbilical

modules.module_brief: Gravity-base concrete foundation on the seabed at the scene origin with a padeye/gantry tether attachment; the structure root of the deployed system.

sub_modules.topology_clause: flat on the seabed (z=0) at the scene origin; padeye gantry on top centre receives the tether

actuation commands for elevator/rudder trajectory control

operating_height_above_seabed_m.source_detail: device flies 15-40 m below MSL in 60-120 m water
